'''Reduce Injury''', also known as '''wound reduction''',<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref> was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] which allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual to reduce the damage suffered by a strike, including an injury that would have [[Death/Legends|killed]] them. The Force-sensitive was still wounded by the strike, but not as severely as they would have been.<ref name="RPG2" />
